raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Refresh the A2/A3 images to CANN 9.2.1 and vLLM 0.30.0 with updated MindSpeed, Megatron adaptor, Transformer Engine NPU, vllm-ascend, Mooncake, and FLA-NPU pins. Adapt the inference server imports and enable the exact-token scale-out endpoint for vLLM 0.30.

Install pinned upstream AWEX compatibility fixes and preserve that installation during application dependency setup. Remove the redundant local AWEX shim and the content-parts patch now included in vLLM; retain and update the exact-token validation patch.

## Related Issue

Related to #1612 (exact-token generation compatibility).

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):** No public API removal is intended; the image and server integration target vLLM 0.30.

## Additional Context

Validation: `pre-commit run --all-files` ran against an isolated copy of the committed tree; all checks passed after rerunning `pre-commit run uv-lock --all-files` with cache access. Commit hooks passed, and the squashed tree was verified identical to the original three-commit result. Patch documentation was updated; the documentation site was not built.

Image builds and NPU/distributed runtime tests were not run during this publication. Runtime compatibility, exact-token generation, and AWEX weight updates still need hardware validation. Disabling the AWEX source override falls back to the manifest package without the pinned source fixes.

This PR targets `ascend` and preserves commit `9aeb44acc9c7520f09c0c93353eb63a7f0898e8a`; it does not include the later NPU graph-storage reload fix.
